description: agentgateway (MCP, A2A and LLM gateway, /metrics on port 15020): HTTP traffic by backend protocol, MCP calls by method, target server and tool, MCP outcomes, LLM tokens, latency, cost and guardrails, connections and config sync.

panels.title: Requests/s
panels.description: HTTP requests handled by the gateway (all backend protocols).

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of responses with a 5xx status, upstream or generated by the gateway.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(agentgateway_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gateway=~"$gateway", status=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(agentgateway_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gateway=~"$gateway"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Request p95
panels.description: 95th percentile HTTP request duration at the gateway.

panels.title: MCP calls/s
panels.description: MCP JSON-RPC requests per second (initialize, tools/list, tools/call...).

panels.title: MCP error ratio
panels.description: MCP requests whose outcome is tool_error, protocol_error or gateway_error.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(agentgateway_mcp_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gateway=~"$gateway", outcome=~"tool_error|protocol_error|gateway_error"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(agentgateway_mcp_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gateway=~"$gateway"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: LLM cost in range
panels.description: USD cost of LLM requests over the selected range, from the gateway model cost catalog.

panels.title: Requests by backend protocol and status
panels.description: protocol is the backend type: http, mcp, a2a, llm or tcp.

panels.title: Gateway-generated responses
panels.description: Responses not produced by the backend: auth failures (JwtAuth, APIKeyAuth, ExtAuth, Authorization), rate limits, NoHealthyBackend, timeouts.

targets.expr: sum by (reason, status) (rate(agentgateway_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gateway=~"$gateway", reason!="Upstream"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Request latency
panels.description: HTTP request duration measured by the gateway, including the backend.

panels.title: Gateway overhead (p95)
panels.description: Time spent inside the gateway before the outbound call and after the response (policies, transformations, guardrails).

panels.title: In-flight requests and upstream connections
panels.description: Requests awaiting a complete response and open upstream connections per backend.

panels.title: Retries and load shedding
panels.description: Retries sent to backends and requests or connections rejected by the in-flight and connection limits.

panels.title: MCP requests by method
panels.description: MCP JSON-RPC requests per method.

panels.title: MCP outcomes
panels.description: success; tool_error = the tool returned isError; protocol_error = JSON-RPC error; gateway_error = 4xx/5xx or a gateway failure; unknown = no result seen (e.g. streamed).

panels.title: MCP calls by target server
panels.description: Requests per upstream MCP server (target) after multiplexing.

panels.title: MCP errors by server
panels.description: Failed MCP requests per target and outcome.

panels.title: Top tools (range)
panels.description: Most called tools over the selected range.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (server, resource) (increase(agentgateway_mcp_requests_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gateway=~"$gateway", resource_type="tool"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Tool, prompt and resource calls
panels.description: MCP requests that target a tool, prompt, resource, resource template or task.

panels.title: Tokens by model
panels.description: Input, output and cache tokens per second by requested model.

panels.title: Cost rate by model
panels.description: USD per hour by requested model.

panels.title: LLM request duration p95 by model
panels.description: Duration of LLM requests through the gateway.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, gen_ai_request_model) (rate(agentgateway_gen_ai_server_request_duration_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gateway=~"$gateway"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Time to first token p95 by model
panels.description: Streaming time to first token from the provider.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, gen_ai_request_model) (rate(agentgateway_gen_ai_server_time_to_first_token_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gateway=~"$gateway"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Time per output token p95 by model
panels.description: Decode speed as seen by the gateway.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, gen_ai_request_model) (rate(agentgateway_gen_ai_server_time_per_output_token_bucket{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", gateway=~"$gateway"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Failed LLM requests by model
panels.description: LLM requests recorded with error_type=_OTHER.

panels.title: Guardrail checks
panels.description: Guardrail verdicts on requests and responses: allow, mask, reject, audit, failOpen.

panels.title: Cost catalog lookups
panels.description: Model price lookups by result. Misses mean the cost metric undercounts for that model.

panels.title: Downstream connections
panels.description: New client connections per second by protocol.

panels.title: Upstream connect and TLS handshake (p95)
panels.description: Time to open upstream connections and to complete inbound TLS handshakes.

panels.title: Config synchronized
panels.description: 1 when the last configuration load or reload succeeded, 0 when the running config is stale.

panels.title: Traffic volume
panels.description: Bytes received from and sent to clients.

title: agentgateway
